adjusts.description: Uncalibrated attenuation setting in dB (0 to 115 dB in 0.25 dB steps)
adjusts.name: attenuation_setting

facts.text: MiniCircuitsRCDAT is the Mini-Circuits USB switch attenuator class and fixes product ID 0x23
The Mini-Circuits USB base class declares vendor ID 0x20CE for USB HID devices
The uncalibrated attenuation_setting property is bounded to 0 to 115 dB with a 0.25 dB step
attenuation_setting reads with command code 18 and writes with command code 19
The attenuation setter sends the whole-decibel part and the quarter-decibel part, plus the channel
channel selects a port from 1 to 4, and None addresses a single attenuator
frequency selects the calibration-table row and is bounded to 10 MHz to 6 GHz
attenuation is the calibrated value from the table at calibration_path, indexed by frequency
model and serial_number are read with command codes 40 and 41
A command is at most 64 one-byte values and the reply must echo the command code within timeout
open() resolves the HID path and opens it in nonblocking mode
The USB command timeout defaults to 1 s and its minimum is 0.5 s
The serial number is required when more than one device is connected
